name: Nyannyaka Daisakusen
source:
The main character Kaiba Mari is a perfect man, Good looks, Have excellent reflexes, Clever, and Ultrarich.
But he is bored with his life because he has everything he wants to have.
One day, He finds a memento of his grand father in a storehouse.
It is Neko-neko cane, used to make any women horny.

He wants his own nekomimi girl!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ028385.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角海马Mari是个完美男人：相貌出众、反应敏捷、聪明绝顶，还是个超级富豪。但他拥有想要的一切，生活也因此变得无聊。某天，他在仓库发现祖父留下的遗物：一根猫猫魔杖，可以让任何女人欲火焚身。

他想要一位猫耳娘！[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ028385.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
